onboarding.step1d: A daily quote, an intention and three main tasks. The day starts consciously, not with notifications.
onboarding.step2d: Tasks marked the Stoic way: “up to me” or “not up to me”. Energy goes only where you make a difference.
onboarding.step3d: Seneca's four questions: what went well, what was outside your control, what you learned, what you're grateful for.

today.obstaclesPh: What may get in the way? How will I respond?
today.morningDoneSub: Have a good day. See you in the evening.
today.eveningDoneSub: The day is closed. The entry went to your journal.
today.skippedNote: Morning skipped — that is practice too. Start right with the evening.

journal.title: Journal
journal.privacy: Your journal is visible only to you — enforced at the database level
journal.contentPh: What would you like to write about?
journal.empty: No entries yet. Evening reviews and practices create them automatically.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.empty: No tasks. Empty is order too.

guide.title: Practice guide
guide.subtitle: Stoic exercises — from the dichotomy of control to the evening review. Practice, don't just read.
